exposure: Pre-conceptional hyperandrogenism in women with PCOS
cohort: The study included pregnant patients diagnosed with PCOS with or without pre-conceptional hyperandrogenism, excluding those with multiple pregnancies or who received assisted reproductive technology, oral contraceptives, or spironolactone.
finding: Pregnant women with PCOS and pre-conceptional hyperandrogenism showed a significantly higher risk of large for gestational age and preterm birth.
mod_finding: There was no significant increase in the risk of cesarean section among women with PCOS and pre-conceptional hyperandrogenism.
birth_weight: Large for gestational age (as an outcome)
gest_age: Preterm birth and Large for gestational age (as outcomes)
